subject: Vendor onboarding: Acme Logistics - provisional PO and line-item triage
messages:
From: Elena Soto <elena@acmelogistics.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: New vendor onboarding: Acme Logistics — PO issuance & spend cap request

Hi Tessa / Monica,

Thanks for taking the call this morning. As discussed, Acme Logistics is ready to be set up as a vendor so we can start the services engagement. Quick summary of what we need from Redwood to move forward: 

- Provisional PO number to reference in our billing while vendor verification completes.
- Initial spend cap: our finance team requested an initial cap of $150,000 for Q3 scope; happy to split by line if needed.
- Map the SOW line items to Redwood SKU/ledger categories (there are 3 billed line items in the SOW).

I've attached a completed W-9 and the signed SOW for your records. Can you confirm the estimated timeline for PO issuance and whether we need any additional vendor forms? Also please advise which email the invoices should be sent to so we route them correctly.

Best,
Elena Soto
Vendor Relations
Acme Logistics

Attachments: W9_AcmeLogistics.pdf (application/pdf - 145KB), Acme_SOW_signed.pdf (application/pdf - 220KB)

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena@acmelogistics.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding: Acme Logistics — PO issuance & spend cap request

Hi Elena — thanks for sending the docs and for the call earlier.

Quick notes / next steps from our side: 
1) Finance will need to validate the W-9 and run the vendor setup in the AP system. Monica is looping in Finance verification below.
2) We can provide a provisional PO number prior to final vendor code assignment; provisional POs are typically issued same day if verification is straightforward.
3) On the spend cap: $150K is fine to request, but Procurement may stage an initial smaller cap until the first invoice run — they'll flag if they want to start at a conservative amount.
4) Please confirm the three SOW line descriptions exactly as you'd like them mapped to invoice line names. That will speed ledger mapping and reduce later line-item corrections.

Attaching our onboarding checklist for vendor-side fields that sometimes delay setup (banking, remittance email, tax contact, etc.). If you can confirm the invoice email and banking remit instructions by EOD, I’ll put the PO request into the queue.

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Sr. Procurement Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachment: vendor_onboarding_checklist.pdf (application/pdf - 40KB)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 12:15:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: New vendor onboarding: Acme Logistics — PO issuance & spend cap request

Tessa / Monica —

I reviewed the packet and authorized a provisional PO this morning. Details below (please update the ledger and vendor request ticket):

- Provisional PO: P-2025-0841-PROV
- Issued by: Procurement (Jonas Weber)
- Initial spend cap: $100,000 (provisioned). We can increase to $150,000 after first invoice reconciliation and confirmation of remittance routing.
- Vendor verification: W-9 ok; bank details still pending (Finance to confirm).

Line-item triage (SOW vs ledger mapping) — please apply these corrections before routing the PO to Billing: 
1) SOW line "Onboarding & Integration" (listed as 1 x $45,000) -> split into two ledger lines: "Professional Services - Integration" (1 x $30,000) and "Project Management" (1 x $15,000).
2) SOW line "Monthly Support" (listed as 12 x $3,500 = $42,000) -> correct quantity to 6 months for Q3 pilot (6 x $3,500 = $21,000) with a renewal note. We’ll set a conditional auto-approval on renewal if metrics pass.
3) SOW line "Usage-based transport fees" has a placeholder SKU; map to ledger "Logistics Variable Fees" and mark as "estimate" until actuals arrive.

Action items:
- Monica: kick the AP vendor setup and validate banking details; if bank info isn’t in by EOD Wed (2025-07-02) we leave the provisional PO in a pending-state.
- Tessa: create the PO in the procurement system with the triaged line items above and set spending cap to $100K. Tag ticket: #VND-ACME-2104 and add HubSpot link.

Related links: https://hubspot.example/contacts/ACME-12345 | DocuSign: https://docu.sign/example/req-4567

Jonas
Procurement Lead
Redwood Inference

- For the "Monthly Support" line: we confirm 6 months for the pilot; when renewal triggers we'll route a short change order.
- Invoices should be sent to: finance@acmelogistics.com (cc: ap@acme). Can you confirm Redwood's invoice routing so our AR team knows where to send?
